summary: Comprehensive test suite with good end-to-end validation. Covers all major functions, multiple manifest formats, output formats, error paths, and workflow integration through act. Strong points: clear organization, mocking demonstration, fixture-based scenarios, artifact verification, actionlint validation, exact output assertions. Weaknesses: limited isolated edge case tests (e.g., requirements.txt parsing combines multiple scenarios), no malformed config/database tests, brittle assertions on exact output format, heavy external tool dependencies (python3, docker, act, actionlint), fixtures defined externally with no documented schema. Would catch most regressions but would benefit from more thorough edge case isolation and error scenario coverage before production use.
